1	import { LayerNode } from "@opencode-ai/core/effect/layer-node"
2	import { SessionV1 } from "@opencode-ai/core/v1/session"
3	import { ConfigV1 } from "@opencode-ai/core/v1/config/config"
4	import { Session } from "./session"
5	import { SessionID, MessageID, PartID } from "./schema"
6	import { Provider } from "@/provider/provider"
7	import { MessageV2 } from "./message-v2"
8	import { Token } from "@/util/token"
9	import { SessionProcessor } from "./processor"
10	import { Agent } from "@/agent/agent"
11	import { Plugin } from "@/plugin"
12	import { Config } from "@/config/config"
13	import { NotFoundError } from "@/storage/storage"
14	
15	import { Effect, Layer, Context } from "effect"
16	import { InstanceState } from "@/effect/instance-state"
17	import { isOverflow as overflow, usable } from "./overflow"
18	import { serviceUse } from "@opencode-ai/core/effect/service-use"
19	import { RuntimeFlags } from "@/effect/runtime-flags"
20	import { EventV2Bridge } from "@/event-v2-bridge"
21	import { ProviderV2 } from "@opencode-ai/core/provider"
22	import { ModelV2 } from "@opencode-ai/core/model"
23	import { buildPrompt } from "@opencode-ai/core/session/compaction"
24	import { SessionCompactionEvent } from "@opencode-ai/schema/session-compaction-event"
25	
26	export const Event = SessionCompactionEvent
27	
28	export const PRUNE_MINIMUM = 20_000
29	export const PRUNE_PROTECT = 40_000
30	const TOOL_OUTPUT_MAX_CHARS = 2_000
31	const PRUNE_PROTECTED_TOOLS = ["skill"]
32	const MIN_PRESERVE_RECENT_TOKENS = 2_000
33	const MAX_PRESERVE_RECENT_TOKENS = 15_000
34	type Turn = {
35	  start: number
36	  end: number
37	  id: MessageID
38	}
39	
40	type Tail = {
41	  start: number
42	  id: MessageID
43	}
44	
45	type CompletedCompaction = {
46	  userIndex: number
47	  assistantIndex: number
48	  summary: string | undefined
49	}
50	
51	const truncate = (value: string) =>
52	  value.length <= TOOL_OUTPUT_MAX_CHARS ? value : `${value.slice(0, TOOL_OUTPUT_MAX_CHARS)}\n[truncated]`
53	
54	const serialize = (message: SessionV1.WithParts) => {
55	  if (message.info.role === "user") {
56	    const text = message.parts
57	      .filter((part): part is SessionV1.TextPart => part.type === "text" && !part.ignored)
58	      .map((part) => part.text)
59	      .filter(Boolean)
60	      .join("\n")
61	    const files = message.parts.flatMap((part) =>
62	      part.type === "file" ? [`[Attached ${part.mime}: ${part.filename ?? "file"}]`] : [],
63	    )
64	    return [...(text ? [`[User]: ${text}`] : []), ...files].join("\n")
65	  }
66	  return message.parts
67	    .flatMap((part) => {
68	      if (part.type === "text") return part.text ? [`[Assistant]: ${part.text}`] : []
69	      if (part.type === "reasoning") return part.text ? [`[Assistant reasoning]: ${part.text}`] : []
70	      if (part.type !== "tool") return []
71	      const call = `[Assistant tool call]: ${part.tool}(${JSON.stringify(part.state.input)})`
72	      if (part.state.status === "completed") {
73	        const attachments = (part.state.attachments ?? []).map(
74	          (item) => `[Attached ${item.mime}: ${item.filename ?? "file"}]`,
75	        )
76	        const output = part.state.time.compacted
77	          ? "[Old tool result content cleared]"
78	          : truncate([part.state.output, ...attachments].join("\n"))
79	        return [call, `[Tool result]: ${output}`]
80	      }
81	      if (part.state.status === "error") return [call, `[Tool error]: ${part.state.error}`]
82	      return [call]
83	    })
84	    .join("\n")
85	}
86	
87	function summaryText(message: SessionV1.WithParts) {
88	  const text = message.parts
89	    .filter((part): part is SessionV1.TextPart => part.type === "text")
90	    .map((part) => part.text.trim())
91	    .filter(Boolean)
92	    .join("\n\n")
93	    .trim()
94	  return text || undefined
95	}
96	
97	function completedCompactions(messages: SessionV1.WithParts[]) {
98	  const users = new Map<MessageID, number>()
99	  for (let i = 0; i < messages.length; i++) {
100	    const msg = messages[i]
101	    if (msg.info.role !== "user") continue
102	    if (!msg.parts.some((part) => part.type === "compaction")) continue
103	    users.set(msg.info.id, i)
104	  }
105	
106	  return messages.flatMap((msg, assistantIndex): CompletedCompaction[] => {
107	    if (msg.info.role !== "assistant") return []
108	    if (!msg.info.summary || !msg.info.finish || msg.info.error) return []
109	    const userIndex = users.get(msg.info.parentID)
110	    if (userIndex === undefined) return []
111	    return [{ userIndex, assistantIndex, summary: summaryText(msg) }]
112	  })
113	}
114	
115	function preserveRecentBudget(input: { cfg: ConfigV1.Info; model: Provider.Model }) {
116	  return (
117	    input.cfg.compaction?.preserve_recent_tokens ??
118	    Math.min(MAX_PRESERVE_RECENT_TOKENS, Math.max(MIN_PRESERVE_RECENT_TOKENS, Math.floor(usable(input) * 0.25)))
119	  )
120	}
121	
122	function turns(messages: SessionV1.WithParts[]) {
123	  const result: Turn[] = []
124	  for (let i = 0; i < messages.length; i++) {
125	    const msg = messages[i]
126	    if (msg.info.role !== "user") continue
127	    if (msg.parts.some((part) => part.type === "compaction")) continue
128	    result.push({
129	      start: i,
130	      end: messages.length,
131	      id: msg.info.id,
132	    })
133	  }
134	  for (let i = 0; i < result.length - 1; i++) {
135	    result[i].end = result[i + 1].start
136	  }
137	  return result
138	}
139	
140	function splitTurn(input: {
141	  messages: SessionV1.WithParts[]
142	  turn: Turn
143	  model: Provider.Model
144	  budget: number
145	  estimate: (input: { messages: SessionV1.WithParts[]; model: Provider.Model }) => Effect.Effect<number>
146	}) {
147	  return Effect.gen(function* () {
148	    if (input.budget <= 0) return undefined
149	    if (input.turn.end - input.turn.start <= 1) return undefined
150	    for (let start = input.turn.start + 1; start < input.turn.end; start++) {
151	      const size = yield* input.estimate({
152	        messages: input.messages.slice(start, input.turn.end),
153	        model: input.model,
154	      })
155	      if (size > input.budget) continue
156	      return {
157	        start,
158	        id: input.messages[start]!.info.id,
159	      } satisfies Tail
160	    }
161	    return undefined
162	  })
163	}
164	
165	export interface Interface {
166	  readonly isOverflow: (input: {
167	    tokens: SessionV1.Assistant["tokens"]
168	    model: Provider.Model
169	  }) => Effect.Effect<boolean>
170	  readonly prune: (input: { sessionID: SessionID }) => Effect.Effect<void>
171	  readonly process: (input: {
172	    parentID: MessageID
173	    messages: SessionV1.WithParts[]
174	    sessionID: SessionID
175	    auto: boolean
176	    overflow?: boolean
177	  }) => Effect.Effect<"continue" | "stop">
178	  readonly create: (input: {
179	    sessionID: SessionID
180	    agent: string
181	    model: { providerID: ProviderV2.ID; modelID: ModelV2.ID }
182	    auto: boolean
183	    overflow?: boolean
184	  }) => Effect.Effect<void>
185	}
186	
187	export class Service extends Context.Service<Service, Interface>()("@opencode/SessionCompaction") {}
188	
189	export const use = serviceUse(Service)
190	
191	const layer = Layer.effect(
192	  Service,
193	  Effect.gen(function* () {
194	    const config = yield* Config.Service
195	    const session = yield* Session.Service
196	    const agents = yield* Agent.Service
197	    const plugin = yield* Plugin.Service
198	    const processors = yield* SessionProcessor.Service
199	    const provider = yield* Provider.Service
200	    const events = yield* EventV2Bridge.Service
201	    const flags = yield* RuntimeFlags.Service
202	
203	    const isOverflow = Effect.fn("SessionCompaction.isOverflow")(function* (input: {
204	      tokens: SessionV1.Assistant["tokens"]
205	      model: Provider.Model
206	    }) {
207	      return overflow({
208	        cfg: yield* config.get(),
209	        tokens: input.tokens,
210	        model: input.model,
211	        outputTokenMax: flags.outputTokenMax,
212	      })
213	    })
214	
215	    const estimate = Effect.fn("SessionCompaction.estimate")(function* (input: {
216	      messages: SessionV1.WithParts[]
217	      model: Provider.Model
218	    }) {
219	      const msgs = yield* MessageV2.toModelMessagesEffect(input.messages, input.model)
220	      return Token.estimate(JSON.stringify(msgs))
221	    })
222	
223	    const select = Effect.fn("SessionCompaction.select")(function* (input: {
224	      messages: SessionV1.WithParts[]
225	      cfg: ConfigV1.Info
226	      model: Provider.Model
227	    }) {
228	      const limit = input.cfg.compaction?.tail_turns
229	      if (limit !== undefined && limit <= 0) return { head: input.messages, tail_start_id: undefined }
230	      const budget = preserveRecentBudget({ cfg: input.cfg, model: input.model })
231	      const all = turns(input.messages)
232	      if (!all.length) return { head: input.messages, tail_start_id: undefined }
233	      const recent = limit === undefined ? all : all.slice(-limit)
234	
235	      let total = 0
236	      let keep: Tail | undefined
237	      for (let i = recent.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
238	        const turn = recent[i]!
239	        // estimate lazily so cost stays proportional to the retained tail, not the whole session
240	        const size = yield* estimate({
241	          messages: input.messages.slice(turn.start, turn.end),
242	          model: input.model,
243	        })
244	        if (total + size <= budget) {
245	          total += size
246	          keep = { start: turn.start, id: turn.id }
247	          continue
248	        }
249	        const remaining = budget - total
250	        const split = yield* splitTurn({
251	          messages: input.messages,
252	          turn,
253	          model: input.model,
254	          budget: remaining,
255	          estimate,
256	        })
257	        if (split) keep = split
258	        else if (!keep) {
259	          yield* Effect.logInfo("tail fallback", { budget, size, total })
260	        }
261	        break
262	      }
263	
264	      if (!keep || keep.start === 0) return { head: input.messages, tail_start_id: undefined }
265	      return {
266	        head: input.messages.slice(0, keep.start),
267	        tail_start_id: keep.id,
268	      }
269	    })
270	
271	    // goes backwards through parts until there are PRUNE_PROTECT tokens worth of tool
272	    // calls, then erases output of older tool calls to free context space
273	    const prune = Effect.fn("SessionCompaction.prune")(function* (input: { sessionID: SessionID }) {
274	      const cfg = yield* config.get()
275	      if (!cfg.compaction?.prune) return
276	      yield* Effect.logInfo("pruning")
277	
278	      const msgs = yield* session
279	        .messages({ sessionID: input.sessionID })
280	        .pipe(Effect.catchIf(NotFoundError.isInstance, () => Effect.succeed(undefined)))
281	      if (!msgs) return
282	
283	      let total = 0
284	      let pruned = 0
285	      const toPrune: SessionV1.ToolPart[] = []
286	      let turns = 0
287	
288	      loop: for (let msgIndex = msgs.length - 1; msgIndex >= 0; msgIndex--) {
289	        const msg = msgs[msgIndex]
290	        if (msg.info.role === "user") turns++
291	        if (turns < 2) continue
292	        if (msg.info.role === "assistant" && msg.info.summary) break loop
293	        for (let partIndex = msg.parts.length - 1; partIndex >= 0; partIndex--) {
294	          const part = msg.parts[partIndex]
295	          if (part.type !== "tool") continue
296	          if (part.state.status !== "completed") continue
297	          if (PRUNE_PROTECTED_TOOLS.includes(part.tool)) continue
298	          if (part.state.time.compacted) break loop
299	          const estimate = Token.estimate(part.state.output)
300	          total += estimate
301	          if (total <= PRUNE_PROTECT) continue
302	          pruned += estimate
303	          toPrune.push(part)
304	        }
305	      }
306	
307	      yield* Effect.logInfo("found", { pruned, total })
308	      if (pruned > PRUNE_MINIMUM) {
309	        for (const part of toPrune) {
310	          if (part.state.status === "completed") {
311	            part.state.time.compacted = Date.now()
312	            yield* session.updatePart(part)
313	          }
314	        }
315	        yield* Effect.logInfo("pruned", { count: toPrune.length })
316	      }
317	    })
318	
319	    const processCompaction = Effect.fn("SessionCompaction.process")(function* (input: {
320	      parentID: MessageID
321	      messages: SessionV1.WithParts[]
322	      sessionID: SessionID
323	      auto: boolean
324	      overflow?: boolean
325	    }) {
326	      const parent = input.messages.findLast((m) => m.info.id === input.parentID)
327	      if (!parent || parent.info.role !== "user") {
328	        throw new Error(`Compaction parent must be a user message: ${input.parentID}`)
329	      }
330	      const userMessage = parent.info
331	      const compactionPart = parent.parts.find((part): part is SessionV1.CompactionPart => part.type === "compaction")
332	
333	      let messages = input.messages
334	      let replay:
335	        | {
336	            info: SessionV1.User
337	            parts: SessionV1.Part[]
338	          }
339	        | undefined
340	      if (input.overflow) {
341	        const idx = input.messages.findIndex((m) => m.info.id === input.parentID)
342	        for (let i = idx - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
343	          const msg = input.messages[i]
344	          if (msg.info.role === "user" && !msg.parts.some((p) => p.type === "compaction")) {
345	            replay = { info: msg.info, parts: msg.parts }
346	            messages = input.messages.slice(0, i)
347	            break
348	          }
349	        }
350	        const hasContent =
351	          replay && messages.some((m) => m.info.role === "user" && !m.parts.some((p) => p.type === "compaction"))
352	        if (!hasContent) {
353	          replay = undefined
354	          messages = input.messages
355	        }
356	      }
357	
358	      const agent = yield* agents.get("compaction")
359	      const model = agent.model
360	        ? yield* provider.getModel(agent.model.providerID, agent.model.modelID).pipe(Effect.orDie)
361	        : yield* provider.getModel(userMessage.model.providerID, userMessage.model.modelID).pipe(Effect.orDie)
362	      const cfg = yield* config.get()
363	      const history = compactionPart && messages.at(-1)?.info.id === input.parentID ? messages.slice(0, -1) : messages
364	      const prior = completedCompactions(history)
365	      const hidden = new Set(prior.flatMap((item) => [item.userIndex, item.assistantIndex]))
366	      const previousSummary = prior.at(-1)?.summary
367	      const selected = yield* select({
368	        messages: history.filter((_, index) => !hidden.has(index)),
369	        cfg,
370	        model,
371	      })
372	      // Allow plugins to inject context or replace compaction prompt.
373	      const compacting = yield* plugin.trigger(
374	        "experimental.session.compacting",
375	        { sessionID: input.sessionID },
376	        { context: [], prompt: undefined },
377	      )
378	      const msgs = structuredClone(selected.head)
379	      yield* plugin.trigger("experimental.chat.messages.transform", {}, { messages: msgs })
380	      const conversation = msgs.map(serialize).filter(Boolean).join("\n\n")
381	      const nextPrompt =
382	        compacting.prompt ??
383	        [
384	          buildPrompt({
385	            previousSummary,
386	            context: [conversation],
387	          }),
388	          ...compacting.context,
389	        ]
390	          .filter(Boolean)
391	          .join("\n\n")
392	      const ctx = yield* InstanceState.context
393	      const msg: SessionV1.Assistant = {
394	        id: MessageID.ascending(),
395	        role: "assistant",
396	        parentID: input.parentID,
397	        sessionID: input.sessionID,
398	        mode: "compaction",
399	        agent: "compaction",
400	        variant: userMessage.model.variant,
401	        summary: true,
402	        path: {
403	          cwd: ctx.directory,
404	          root: ctx.worktree,
405	        },
406	        cost: 0,
407	        tokens: {
408	          output: 0,
409	          input: 0,
410	          reasoning: 0,
411	          cache: { read: 0, write: 0 },
412	        },
413	        modelID: model.id,
414	        providerID: model.providerID,
415	        time: {
416	          created: Date.now(),
417	        },
418	      }
419	      yield* session.updateMessage(msg)
420	      const processor = yield* processors.create({
421	        assistantMessage: msg,
422	        sessionID: input.sessionID,
423	        model,
424	      })
425	      const result = yield* processor.process({
426	        user: userMessage,
427	        agent,
428	        sessionID: input.sessionID,
429	        tools: {},
430	        system: [],
431	        messages: [
432	          {
433	            role: "user",
434	            content: [
435	              {
436	                type: "text",
437	                text: [
438	                  nextPrompt,
439	                  ...(compacting.prompt ? ["The following is the conversation history:", conversation] : []),
440	                ]
441	                  .filter(Boolean)
442	                  .join("\n\n"),
443	              },
444	            ],
445	          },
446	        ],
447	        model,
448	      })
449	
450	      if (result === "compact") {
451	        processor.message.error = new SessionV1.ContextOverflowError({
452	          message: replay
453	            ? "Conversation history too large to compact - exceeds model context limit"
454	            : "Session too large to compact - context exceeds model limit even after stripping media",
455	        }).toObject()
456	        processor.message.finish = "error"
457	        yield* session.updateMessage(processor.message)
458	        return "stop"
459	      }
460	
461	      if (compactionPart && selected.tail_start_id && compactionPart.tail_start_id !== selected.tail_start_id) {
462	        yield* session.updatePart({
463	          ...compactionPart,
464	          tail_start_id: selected.tail_start_id,
465	        })
466	      }
467	
468	      if (result === "continue" && input.auto) {
469	        if (replay) {
470	          const original = replay.info
471	          const replayMsg = yield* session.updateMessage({
472	            id: MessageID.ascending(),
473	            role: "user",
474	            sessionID: input.sessionID,
475	            time: { created: Date.now() },
476	            agent: original.agent,
477	            model: original.model,
478	            format: original.format,
479	            tools: original.tools,
480	            system: original.system,
481	          })
482	          for (const part of replay.parts) {
483	            if (part.type === "compaction") continue
484	            const replayPart =
485	              part.type === "file" && MessageV2.isMedia(part.mime)
486	                ? { type: "text" as const, text: `[Attached ${part.mime}: ${part.filename ?? "file"}]` }
487	                : part
488	            yield* session.updatePart({
489	              ...replayPart,
490	              id: PartID.ascending(),
491	              messageID: replayMsg.id,
492	              sessionID: input.sessionID,
493	            })
494	          }
495	        }
496	
497	        if (!replay) {
498	          const info = yield* provider.getProvider(userMessage.model.providerID)
499	          if (
500	            (yield* plugin.trigger(
501	              "experimental.compaction.autocontinue",
502	              {
503	                sessionID: input.sessionID,
504	                agent: userMessage.agent,
505	                model: yield* provider
506	                  .getModel(userMessage.model.providerID, userMessage.model.modelID)
507	                  .pipe(Effect.orDie),
508	                provider: {
509	                  source: info.source,
510	                  info,
511	                  options: info.options,
512	                },
513	                message: userMessage,
514	                overflow: input.overflow === true,
515	              },
516	              { enabled: true },
517	            )).enabled
518	          ) {
519	            const continueMsg = yield* session.updateMessage({
520	              id: MessageID.ascending(),
521	              role: "user",
522	              sessionID: input.sessionID,
523	              time: { created: Date.now() },
524	              agent: userMessage.agent,
525	              model: userMessage.model,
526	            })
527	            const text =
528	              (input.overflow
529	                ? "The previous request exceeded the provider's size limit due to large media attachments. The conversation was compacted and media files were removed from context. If the user was asking about attached images or files, explain that the attachments were too large to process and suggest they try again with smaller or fewer files.\n\n"
530	                : "") +
531	              "Continue if you have next steps, or stop and ask for clarification if you are unsure how to proceed."
532	            yield* session.updatePart({
533	              id: PartID.ascending(),
534	              messageID: continueMsg.id,
535	              sessionID: input.sessionID,
536	              type: "text",
537	              // Internal marker for auto-compaction followups so provider plugins
538	              // can distinguish them from manual post-compaction user prompts.
539	              // This is not a stable plugin contract and may change or disappear.
540	              metadata: { compaction_continue: true },
541	              synthetic: true,
542	              text,
543	              time: {
544	                start: Date.now(),
545	                end: Date.now(),
546	              },
547	            })
548	          }
549	        }
550	      }
551	
552	      if (processor.message.error) return "stop"
553	      if (result === "continue") {
554	        yield* events.publish(Event.Compacted, { sessionID: input.sessionID })
555	      }
556	      return result
557	    })
558	
559	    const create = Effect.fn("SessionCompaction.create")(function* (input: {
560	      sessionID: SessionID
561	      agent: string
562	      model: { providerID: ProviderV2.ID; modelID: ModelV2.ID }
563	      auto: boolean
564	      overflow?: boolean
565	    }) {
566	      const msg = yield* session.updateMessage({
567	        id: MessageID.ascending(),
568	        role: "user",
569	        model: input.model,
570	        sessionID: input.sessionID,
571	        agent: input.agent,
572	        time: { created: Date.now() },
573	      })
574	      yield* session.updatePart({
575	        id: PartID.ascending(),
576	        messageID: msg.id,
577	        sessionID: msg.sessionID,
578	        type: "compaction",
579	        auto: input.auto,
580	        overflow: input.overflow,
581	      })
582	    })
583	
584	    return Service.of({
585	      isOverflow,
586	      prune,
587	      process: processCompaction,
588	      create,
589	    })
590	  }),
591	)
592	
593	export const node = LayerNode.make({
594	  service: Service,
595	  layer: layer,
596	  deps: [
597	    Config.node,
598	    Session.node,
599	    Agent.node,
600	    Plugin.node,
601	    SessionProcessor.node,
602	    Provider.node,
603	    EventV2Bridge.node,
604	    RuntimeFlags.node,
605	  ],
606	})
607	
608	export * as SessionCompaction from "./compaction"

1	import type { Config } from "@/config/config"
2	import { ConfigV1 } from "@opencode-ai/core/v1/config/config"
3	import { SessionV1 } from "@opencode-ai/core/v1/session"
4	import type { Provider } from "@/provider/provider"
5	import { ProviderTransform } from "@/provider/transform"
6	import type { MessageV2 } from "./message-v2"
7	
8	const COMPACTION_BUFFER = 20_000
9	
10	export function usable(input: { cfg: ConfigV1.Info; model: Provider.Model; outputTokenMax?: number }) {
11	  const context = input.model.limit.context
12	  if (context === 0) return 0
13	
14	  const reserved =
15	    input.cfg.compaction?.reserved ??
16	    Math.min(COMPACTION_BUFFER, ProviderTransform.maxOutputTokens(input.model, input.outputTokenMax))
17	  return input.model.limit.input
